name: Hello! My Name is Zack
source:
While taking a walk, you stumble upon a weird guy dragging a dead body to a dumpster.

His name is Zack. 

Maybe you can talk your way out of also going into the dumpster?

[From [url=https://yuyu-mortis.itch.io/hello-my-name-is-zack]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
散步时，你偶然发现一个奇怪的人正在把一具尸体拖到垃圾箱里。

他的名字叫扎克。

也许你可以说服自己不要再进垃圾箱？

[来自[url=https://yuyu-mortis.itch.io/hello-my-name-is-zack]Itch.io[/url]]
